text:
mia: putting this here 44b new customer can't finish the Docker quickstart. first outbound request fails with a TLS verify error, then sdk retries and we end up seeing 503. they pasted the command and logs.

mia: Repro command they ran:
```
# Windows w/ Docker Desktop
docker run --rm -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=pk_live_ABC123 redwood/quickstart:latest node index.js
```

mia: Error dump:
```
Error: request to https://api.redwood.ai/v1/complete failed, reason: certificate has expired (SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED)
... SDK retrying (attempt 2) ...
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
```

onboard-bot: @mia Workspace "newco-team" shows trial/billing incomplete. That usually prevents long-running jobs and billing-only features, but won't produce TLS handshake failures. :information_source:

raj: this looks like classic TLS interception by a corporate proxy. the container (and sometimes Node on windows) doesn't trust the company's intercept CA, so the handshake fails. later 503 could be gateway fallback after retries.

infra-bot: note: related infra ticket INFRA-3621 tracks node image + buildkit interactions where host CAs aren't present inside container. also see DOCKER configs that strip certs.

mia: quick unblock suggestions i gave the customer:
- if you can, run quickstart on a personal machine (no corp proxy) to finish onboarding faster.
- mount host CA into container: `-v /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt:/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt:ro` (linux hosts).
- set `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=/path/to/corp_ca.pem` in container env.

raj: add to that: on Linux you can try `--network=host` for docker, or set `HTTPS_PROXY`/`NO_PROXY` appropriately. on Windows it's trickier because system store and node's store can differ.

mia: customer ran `curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health` and pasteback:
```
* Connected to api.redwood.ai (1.2.3.4) port 443 (#0)
* TLSv1.2 (INTERNAL), Cipher is ...
* Server certificate:
*  subject: CN=api.redwood.ai
*  issuer: OU=Corp-Intercept-CA
* SSL: certificate verify failed
```

support-bot: Confirmed: proxy interception present. Raising support note: suggest adding corp CA to NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS or run on non-managed machine. If cannot, offer temporary hosted devbox from support.

raj: product/ux notes:
- docs: add "Behind corporate proxies" troubleshooting section with Docker mount example, NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS sample, and curl checks.
- sdk: if we see CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED, show a friendlier error: "TLS handshake failed. Common cause: corporate SSL proxy. See https://go.redwood.ai/quickstart-proxy for fixes."

mia: also user was confused by onboarding-bot message about billingthey assumed billing was blocking the quickstart. we should make the onboarding message less ambiguous: billing incomplete = "some features disabled (model selection, long-lived tokens)" and not conflate with network errors.

infra-bot: creating tickets: INFRA-3621 (runtime image CA handling) and DOCS-812 (quickstart proxy troubleshooting).

raj: i'll draft the README blurb + example env vars and open PR for docs. i'll also coordinate a small SDK change for the error text.

mia: support case opened with the customer and we suggested temporary workaround (personal laptop or cloud devbox). will follow up after docs/SDK update. thanks everyone :heart:
